jitx design build --help.stdout:
Usage: jitx design build [OPTIONS] [DESIGN]...

  Build one or more designs in the project.

Positional arguments:
  [DESIGN]...

Arguments:
  [DESIGN]...

Options:
  --all                       Build every design discoverable in the resolved
                              project.
  --dump TEXT                 Write the translated design payload to this path
                              before sending it to the runtime — useful for
                              debugging.
  --dry                       Translate but don't connect to the runtime.
                              Skips the runtime probe and dependency check.
  --host TEXT                 Hostname the runtime is listening on. Only
                              consulted when ``--port`` is supplied without
                              ``--uri``.  [default: localhost]
  --port INTEGER              Port the runtime is listening on. Skips the
                              project-local probe and connects to
                              ``ws://<host>:<port>``.
  --uri TEXT                  Full URI of the runtime (e.g.
                              ``ws://localhost:39365/abc123``). Takes
                              precedence over ``--port`` / ``--socket`` /
                              project probe.
  --socket FILE               Path to a socket file describing the runtime's
                              connection parameters. Used when targeting a
                              runtime outside the resolved project's
                              directory.
  --generate-config           After building, write/refresh the VS Code launch
                              configuration for each discovered design. Only
                              meaningful with ``--all``.
  --no-dependency-check       Skip the pyproject.toml dependency sync step.
  --check-include-group TEXT  Include this dependency group in the pre-build
                              sync check. Repeatable.
  --project PATH              JITX project root (directory containing
                              pyproject.toml with `jitx` as a dependency).
                              Defaults to walking up from the current
                              directory.
  --help                      Show this message and exit.
